note: One rubric for every candidate type, built the same way as Build Day drop 4's. Scores are decision support for a human reviewer, never a pass/fail verdict.

criteria.title: Connect it to the work
criteria.description: Turns a one-line request into a brief: who it is for, what they should do next, which source it rests on, and the deadline.

levels.2: Some questions, no clear reader or action
levels.4: Clear reader, action, source and deadline

criteria.followUp: Ask which missing fact would most change the draft.

criteria.title: Judge the output
criteria.description: Finds the unsupported claim in an AI draft, explains why it matters, and rewrites it from the source.

levels.2: Senses a problem, does not pin it down
levels.3: Cuts the claim and rewrites it
levels.4: Cuts it, explains the risk, rewrites from the source and adds a check

criteria.followUp: Show them a second draft with a softer overclaim and ask how they would catch it.

criteria.title: Own the result
criteria.description: When a published post has an error: corrects it visibly, tells the people affected, and changes the process.

levels.1: Deletes quietly or blames the tool
levels.3: Visible correction and the right people told
levels.4: All of that, plus what changes next time

criteria.followUp: Ask them to draft the one-line correction they would post.
